governing_document.reason: The correction republishes the whole regulatory text with paragraph (g) corrected.

corrections.original_text: where the 3rd stage HPC rotor is exposed
corrections.corrected_text: where the 3rd stage HPC rotor blade is exposed

eligible_parts.description: P/N 6C8368, 6C8403, or a later approved P/N.
A blade modified to P/N 6A8353-001 or 6A8688-001.

required_actions.description: Replace the full set of 3rd stage HPC rotor blades with parts eligible for installation.
required_actions.condition_description: a 3rd stage HPC rotor blade is exposed (removed from the HPC stage 3 to 8 drum)

ambiguities.description: If the next shop visit after the effective date exposes no blade, the text does not say whether the requirement carries forward to a later visit that does, or is spent.
readings: Carry forward: Required at the next shop visit after the effective date where a blade is exposed.
Lapse: Only the first shop visit after the effective date counts; if no blade is exposed then, paragraph (g) is spent.
